source: Codex inspection of the same 16 captions; earlier pilot outputs were already known; not human ground truth and not an independent held-out evaluation. Written before requesting the all-matches model outputs.
metric: For each caption and image-provided candidate, compare present (nonempty spans), absent ([]), or ambiguous (null). Exclude only the five predeclared unresolved candidates. Also report each state separately to expose majority-absent inflation. This does not score exact expression completeness or token mask boundaries.
rules: Do not infer a material from a place: puddle does not establish mud, and beach does not establish sand.
A generic table cannot distinguish table from dining table when both are candidates; luggage cannot distinguish backpack from suitcase. Both compatible candidates should be ambiguous.
The two residual-category cases and three vague device cases remain unresolved; do not count them as correct or incorrect.
